events.Title: Coronal Mass Ejection (CME)
events.Description: A powerful coronal mass ejection raises radiation by 85 units. Unprotected instruments can fail without Safe Mode.

events.Title: Transmitter Overheating
events.Description: The amplifier temporarily overheats, reducing downlink capacity to 45% for 8 ticks.

events.Title: Micrometeoroid Interference
events.Description: A stream of micrometeoroids reduces solar panel output to 60% and raises background radiation by 15 units.
